...But...

Kageaki"Muramasa... what do you think?"
Muramasa"............"
Kageaki"Can an armored warrior really become that strong?"
Muramasa"Honestly, I find it difficult to believe."
Kageaki"Hikaru has inborn talent. Physical technique, operating the machine, heat capacity, the sense for controlling Divine Arts—almost every aspect is beyond perfect."
Kageaki"But even then—"
Muramasa"That far... yes. I would not expect it."
Muramasa"Something else, perhaps. Something beyond mere genius..."
Kageaki"............"
Chachamaru"Explodigy?"
Muramasa"That means nothing."
Chachamaru"Then cabbage prodigy."
Muramasa"Not one corner of that was funny."
Kageaki"I agree."
Muramasa"Then do not say it..."
Kageaki"I said nothing."
Muramasa"Eh?"
Kageaki"..."

Muramasa"Hauah!"
Chachamaru"Phew."
Muramasa"Where are you sprouting from!"
Chachamaru"Sudden rudeness, boss."
Kageaki"It is all right, Muramasa. Not an ally, but for the present not an enemy either."
Chachamaru"Accurate wording. Good evening, bhai!"
Kageaki"Good evening, Your Excellency."
Chachamaru"Fine night."
Kageaki"The moon is visible."
Muramasa"Do not receive her so calmly! Now it looks as though I am the odd one for being surprised!"
Kageaki"I see. My apologies."
Chachamaru"Taking it out on others. Not a good look."
Muramasa"You could simply appear in a less peculiar fashion!"
Chachamaru"My house, no? From which direction apun appears is apun's freedom."

en.html:
Muramasa"What? You are a child of this household? Perhaps I should comment on your parents' upbringing."
Chachamaru"Have none."
Kageaki"Muramasa. This person owns the house."
Muramasa"Hah? But this is a general's mansion, isn't it?"
Kageaki"Yes. Therefore... Her Excellency Chachamaru Ashikaga, Lieutenant General of the Dragon Army, Kubou of Horigoe."
Chachamaru"Be amazed by the information, amazed by the sight. Understood? Then prostrate promptly. Rub that forehead into the tatami, commoner."
Muramasa"Ohhh, is that so? You are the Kubou. You are Her Excellency the Lieutenant General."
Muramasa"—What is that? Appointment by comedy audition?"
Chachamaru"Ah. Actual urge to murder just arrived."
Muramasa"An honest impression. Any objection?"
Chachamaru"Anybody else says it, apun does not care. Why is it, coming from this bamboo armor, the irritation becomes unreasonable?"
Muramasa"W-w-who are you calling bamboo armor!"
Chachamaru"Honest assessment. Objection?"
Muramasa"You are prepared for the consequences, I hope."
Chachamaru"Haan? Want to take this outside?"
Muramasa"Gladly!"
Kageaki"Calm down, Muramasa."
Muramasa"No!"

Muramasa"There!"
Chachamaru"Bhai... Too much spoiling of the tsurugi."
Chachamaru"An inferior work will become still worse, no?"
Kageaki"No. There is no difficulty."
Chachamaru"Really?"
Kageaki"Indulged or otherwise, Muramasa will not forget her own role. At the necessary moment, she will perform the necessary work."
Kageaki"I can trust that without a doubt. For me, that is sufficient."
Muramasa"............"
Kageaki"Unless I betray her trust, Muramasa's performance cannot deteriorate."
Muramasa"And Mido would never betray me, so I can always perform to my full capacity. ...See? That is how it works."
Muramasa"Pilot and tsurugi who recognize each other. Whatever we were before, now we have performed the proper rite and formed our bond. Not a relationship a child's remarks can break."
Muramasa"Understood?"
Chachamaru"Ceiling stains increased since last time, maybe..."
Muramasa"Listen! I was saying something good!"
Chachamaru"Boasting only. Anyway, really planning to drag bhai outside?"
Chachamaru"A bronze bell only gets worse verdigris. Humans catch colds and things, you know."
Muramasa"I know. Obviously I was joking. And who is this bronze bell?"
Kageaki"You are sure?"
Muramasa"It is true I do not want to stay here, or leave you here. But deliberately sleeping outside would be rather foolish."
Muramasa"Besides, Mido, you dislike going back on something you have said."
Kageaki"...Yes."

「自分が村正の信頼を裏切らない限り、村正
の性能が劣化する事など有り得ません」



村正
「そして御堂が私を裏切ることなんて有り得
ないから、私は常に完全な性能を発揮できる。
　……どう？　こういうものなのよ」



村正
「互いを認める仕手と劒冑っていうのはねっ。
　以前はともかく、今の私達はちゃんと帯刀
の儀も済ませて結縁してるの。お子様が何を
言ったって、壊される間柄じゃないんだから」



村正
「わかった？」



茶々丸
「天井のシミ、なんかこないだよりも増えて
ねえかなー」



村正
「聞きなさいよ！
　いい話してたんだから！」



茶々丸
「ただの惚気だろ。
　つかおめー、本気でお兄さん外に引っ張り
出すつもりか？」

茶々丸
「銅鐸は緑青ろくしょうが悪化するだけで済むけどよ、
人間は風邪引いたりとかするんだぜ」



村正
「わかってます。冗談に決まってるでしょ。
　あと銅鐸って誰のことか」



景明
「良いのか？」



村正
「私がここにいたくないのも、御堂を置いて
おきたくないのも本当だけど。
　わざわざ野宿するのもばかみたいだし」



村正
「それに御堂、一度口にしたことを翻すのは
嫌なんでしょ？」



景明
「……そうだな」

Not something I wanted to do.

Muramasa"Do not exaggerate."
Kageaki"Then, Lieutenant General. Once again, I place myself in your care."
Chachamaru"Some very irritating bends in the road, but if that is the conclusion, fine. Make yourself at home, bhai."
Kageaki"Yes."
Muramasa"We shall. Could you leave now? You are in the way."
Chachamaru"...How is there such a gulf in manners between this pilot and tsurugi?"
Chachamaru"You leave! This is bhai's room."
Muramasa"We have no objection to sharing the room. Do we?"
Kageaki"Well."
Chachamaru"Guest-allocation regulations, boss. Apun is running this mansion, not a railway waiting room. You get a proper room also. Go there."
Muramasa"Is that so?"
Chachamaru"Somebody!"

景明 「は」

景明 「まぁ」

村正 「そう？」
茶々丸 「誰かー」
